notes.title: A new day, a new patch
The first mini patch
Torn Away is nearing release
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=k4zJw5J6O-s;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to announce that Torn Away will be released on September 29!

Thank you for your patience and support. Thanks to our console publisher with bringing the game to PS5/4, Xbox and Nintendo Switch. Thanks to publisher Hawthorn Games for helping us release Torn Away for Chinese audiences.

Watch the release date teaser in 4K and don't forget to recommend Torn Away to your friends.

Enjoy your games!

notes.title: Steam Visual Novel Fest + Chinese Localization Update for Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are pleased to announce that Torn Away is now participating in Steam Visual Novel Fest 2023! Our free demo are available now as well as we have updated the localization for it!
